name: Big Chill
abilities: Cryokinesis (freezing breath near absolute zero, freeze rays, ice constructs, cryo-touch)
Intangibility and phasing (can freeze what he passes through)
Flight (outpaced Rex's Boogie Pack) and levitation
Wings fold into a hooded cloak
Space and underwater survivability; radiation resistance
weaknesses: Harmed by fire and vulnerable to electricity
Hypnotised by Psycholeopterrans; ice useless against their intangibility
Certain objects (Rustbucket II netting, Shield of Seagle, Plumber cell doors) can touch him while intangible
Intangibility cancelled by other intangible beings
Vulnerable to sonic vibrations while intangible
Species breeding instinct can override Ben (Save the Last Dance)
summary: A ghostly ice moth that phases through walls and freezes anything it breathes on - Ben's stealth-and-control specialist from Alien Force onward.
traits: Wings fold into a phantom-like hooded robe
Laid eggs and built a metal nest during breeding season (Save the Last Dance)
notableFeats: Froze D'Void's drilling generator solid, defeating him (Voided)
Laid the eggs that hatched into his Necrofriggian offspring (Save the Last Dance)
Defeated Kraab before the Vilgax fight (The Final Battle: Part 1)
Defeated Khyber and escaped his ship (Of Predators and Prey: Part 2)
Froze Emperor Milleous (The Frogs of War: Part 1)

appearances.designNotes: Slender black body with blue chest/limb patches and cyan ice-chunk patches, four moth wings, blue face with harsh black lines, green pupil-less eyes, four teeth; recalibrated Omnitrix symbol on chest. Alien Swarm used a greyer palette with a moving mouth.
Same design as Alien Force with Ultimatrix symbol on chest. Heroes United variant was paler with asymmetric cyan patches.

Bulkier, hunched, larger chest with long black hair draped over it, blue brows and chin stripe, six teeth, bigger bat-like wings and claws, ankle-length robe when folded. 16-year-old wears a green/white belt with the Omnitrix on the waist; the 15-year-old flashback version (Special Delivery) has no belt and the symbol on the chest.

scoring.rationale: Intangibility plus flight make him near-untouchable (defense 8) and let him phase-freeze enemies from inside; froze D'Void's generator and Milleous outright. Survives space, water and radiation. Fire, electricity and Psycholeopterran hypnosis are reliable counters, and his breeding instinct once hijacked Ben.

notes: OV usedBy includes ben-15-af for the Special Delivery flashback (15-year-old Ben in OV art style, Omnitrix on chest); Ben Again use was 11-year-old Ben's mind in 16-year-old Ben's body (counted under ben-16-ov).
Also used by Albedo (Negative Big Chill) in AF, UA (dream) and OV; Film Fan Ben in Duped is Ben.
Heroes United (UA-era) transformations folded into UA appearance.
AF S1 (wiki) = ben-15-af, AF S2 = ben-16-af.
